name: McpVanguard
description: A security proxy and active firewall for the Model Context Protocol that protects host systems from malicious intent, prompt injection, and data exfiltration. It acts as an interception layer between AI agents and tools, providing real-time verification and multi-layered defense mechanisms.

VANGUARD_MODE.description: Run with 'audit' to log security violations as [SHADOW-BLOCK] without actually blocking the agent.

VANGUARD_API_KEY.description: API key used for SSE (Server-Sent Events) stream authorization.

VANGUARD_OLLAMA_URL.description: The URL for a local Ollama instance for local semantic scoring. No API key required.

VANGUARD_OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI semantic scoring. Defaults to using gpt-4o-mini.

VANGUARD_SEMANTIC_CUSTOM_KEY.description: API key for custom semantic inference backends like Groq or DeepSeek.
